description:
Move the no-follow filesystem primitives out of the mutation-session module into a new storage module, point every importer at it, and give the primitives their own error type so redo apply no longer imports from the session module.

## Background

- The primitives live in the 2073-line session module (`crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store.rs`): `CapabilityRoots` with `open` and `root` (`:327-391`), `open_capability_parent` (`:1552`, `pub(in crate::storage)`), `open_or_create_capability_parent` (`:1584`, `pub(in crate::storage)`), `open_descendant_dir_nofollow` (`:1611`, private), `open_child_dir_nofollow` (`:1619`), `open_regular_file_nofollow` (`:1645`), `open_absolute_dir_nofollow` (`:1663`), `read_repository_file_nofollow` (`:1695`), `read_repository_file_confined` (`:1736`), `capability_dir_identity` (`:1868`) (these five `pub(crate)`), the private helpers `read_confined_relative` (`:1749`), `resolve_confined_symlink` (`:1815`), `ensure_capability_identity` (`:1850`) and `capability_metadata_identity` (`:1882`, `:1889`, `:1903`, one per platform), and the private leaf inspector `inspect_capability_leaf` (`:1456-1511`). They return `RepositoryStateStoreError` (`UnsafeTarget(String)` and `Io(#[from] std::io::Error)`, `repository_state_store.rs:80-83`).
- Callers that stay in the session module: `inspect_capability_entry` (`:1403-1423`) calls `inspect_capability_leaf`; `inspect_capability_listing` (`:1426`, call at `:1440`) calls `open_descendant_dir_nofollow`; `entry_identity` (`:1522-1528`) and the Windows `std_metadata_identity` (`:2019-2031`) call `capability_metadata_identity`. `read_confined_relative`, `resolve_confined_symlink` and `ensure_capability_identity` are called only by code that moves (`read_repository_file_confined`, `CapabilityRoots::open` at `:337` and `:357`).
- Other files name moved items through the session module path: `CapabilityRoots` (`crates/jit/src/storage/redo_apply.rs:17-20`, `crates/jit/src/storage/redo_conformance.rs:17`), `open_capability_parent` and `open_or_create_capability_parent` (`redo_apply.rs`, `crates/jit/src/storage/init_publish.rs:14`), `open_child_dir_nofollow` (`redo_apply.rs`, `init_publish.rs`, `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs`, `crates/jit/src/storage/external_publish.rs:188,300,308`, `crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_planning.rs:16`), `open_regular_file_nofollow` (`json.rs`, `artifact_planning.rs`), `open_absolute_dir_nofollow` (`json.rs`, `artifact_planning.rs`, `external_publish.rs:59,93,252`, `crates/jit/src/storage/test_support.rs:41`), `read_repository_file_nofollow` (`crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:177,465`, outside storage), `read_repository_file_confined` (`json.rs`), `capability_dir_identity` (`external_publish.rs:95,97`). The session's test module (`crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs`, `use super::*`) names `CapabilityRoots`, `open_regular_file_nofollow` and `capability_metadata_identity` (`:98-99`, `:533-552`, `:2802-2816`). Further importers: `init_publish.rs:14-16`, `artifact_planning.rs:16-18`, `json.rs` (`:78`, `:99`, `:124`, `:154`, `:940-994`, `:1323-1372`, `:1435`, `:1505`; tests `:1973-1995`), `external_publish.rs` (`:59`, `:93-97`, `:188`, `:252`, `:300-308`).
- `RedoApplyError::Roots(#[from] RepositoryStateStoreError)` (`redo_apply.rs:82`) is why `redo_apply.rs:17-20` imports from the session module, while the session imports `RedoApplier` and `RedoApplyError` back: the import cycle `@/inv/architecture-dependency-direction` forbids.
- Sites that match or build the session error on primitive results: `json.rs:80`, `:942`, `:1325` return `RepositoryStateStoreError::Io` when the data root opens with an error other than not-found; `map_confined_read_error` (`json.rs:1525-1539`) maps `UnsafeTarget` and not-found `Io` of the confined reader; `artifact_planning.rs:228-243` (`is_permission_denied`) downcasts the cause chain to `RepositoryStateStoreError`; the memory backend's `resolve` (`crates/jit/src/storage/memory.rs:628-655`) builds `RepositoryStateStoreError::UnsafeTarget(component).into()` at `:652` for a non-directory ancestor, converting into `RedoApplyError` through `Roots`, and its ancestor parse at `:646-647` converts its own parse error explicitly; `memory.rs:1683` builds `RedoApplyError::Roots(RepositoryStateStoreError::UnsafeTarget(..))`; `init_publish.rs:14-16,54-134` returns `RepositoryStateStoreError` and relies on `?` over primitive results.
- Rust refuses to re-export an item at a wider visibility than the item has (E0364) and the zero-warning clippy run denies unused imports, so each item's visibility must match its real callers.
- The cutover scan in `crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/repository_state_cutover_tests.rs` admits directory-creating functions that name `CapabilityRoots` (`:676`) and checks a `CapabilityRoots` fixture (`:1034`); the moved functions keep those markers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/jit/src/storage/capability_fs.rs` defines `CapabilityRoots`, the parent walks, the no-follow directory and file opens, the repository-file readers and the identity helpers, and `repository_state_store.rs` defines none of them; `inspect_capability_leaf` stays in the session module. Each moved item has the narrowest visibility its callers need: `open_descendant_dir_nofollow` and `capability_metadata_identity` are `pub(in crate::storage)`; `read_confined_relative`, `resolve_confined_symlink` and `ensure_capability_identity` stay private to `capability_fs`; the other items keep their current visibility. `crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs` declares `pub(crate) mod capability_fs`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every importer (the files listed in Background, including `crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs` and the session test module) names the primitives through `crate::storage::capability_fs`; no code names a moved item through `repository_state_store`, which re-exports none of them.
- [hard] REQ-03: `capability_fs.rs` defines `CapabilityFsError` with an unsafe-target, an I/O and a retryable-conflict variant; every primitive returns it, and `From` conversions into `RepositoryStateStoreError` (the retryable conflict into its `RetryableConflict`) and `RedoApplyError` preserve the variant meaning and message text.
- [hard] REQ-04: `RedoApplyError::Roots` wraps `CapabilityFsError`, and `redo_apply.rs` imports nothing from `repository_state_store`.
- [hard] REQ-05: The listed matches, downcasts and constructions, including both memory-backend refusals, use the new type where they inspect or build primitive results.
- [hard] REQ-06: The storage unit suites, the memory-backend, redo conformance, archive-planning and snapshot suites, and the cutover scan pass unchanged.

## Decisions

- D-01: REQ-01 and REQ-03 were amended before implementation (steward ruling, 2026-11-04). A retryable conflict is a real outcome of the moved primitives (`ensure_capability_identity` and `CapabilityRoots::open` build `RetryableConflict`), so the error type carries it as a third variant. `inspect_capability_leaf` stays in the session module: it calls session helpers (`directory_entry`, `normalized_mode`, `entry_identity`) and returns `CaptureError`, so moving it would either recreate the import cycle this issue removes or drag session helpers into the primitives module.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged: callers that report `RepositoryStateStoreError` see the same variants and text through the conversion.
- The memory-backend cycle (`repository_state_store.rs:17` importing `memory`, `memory.rs` importing `ActiveLayoutTracker`) is outside this change.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: No-follow primitives live in one storage module with their own error type
